MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Roll pins and small machine-screw assortments fit my repeated purchases of repair hardware: they give me useful sizes to keep available and complement my cotter pins, metric screws and imperial rivet nuts.",
    "The adhesives and mounting magnets offer ways to attach or repair parts, which connects naturally to my epoxy, mounting tape and hook-and-loop purchases.",
    "Carbide burrs and flap discs fit the work that can follow drilling and cutting: smoothing holes, shaping parts and finishing edges, provided they fit my tools."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The six-inch bolts are hardware I might recognize, but their very specific length and thread require a matching job that I do not currently have.",
    "Calibration weights do not follow from my caliper purchase alone: measuring part dimensions gives me no immediate reason to calibrate a scale."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My fastener purchases seem to have been taken as interest in any bolt, even though a versatile assortment is more useful to me than several identical bolts for one specific application.",
    "My interest in measurement seems to have been extended too broadly from checking dimensions to maintaining a weighing scale."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Exact fit matters: I would check burr shanks, screw threads and seal dimensions, and the recommended 4.5-inch flap discs need a compatibility check given my earlier five-inch cutting wheels.",
    "I often buy assortments to cover different repair needs, but that does not mean I need a large quantity of every supply; three tubes of construction adhesive may exceed my immediate use."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations mostly recognize my interest in practical repair supplies, but sometimes overlook the specific task, dimensions and tool fit that determine whether I can use an item now."
}
